headline: Earnings surge year-over-year despite a seasonal pullback
summary_short: Tapestry reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $1,920.6M, up 21.2% y/y and down 23.3% q/q. Net income rose 69.1% y/y to $343.8M and diluted EPS was $1.65, up 73.7% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue of $1,920.6M rose 21.2% y/y and fell 23.3% q/q. Gross margin was 76.9%, up ~140bp q/q and ~80bp y/y. Operating income rose 68.5% y/y to $427.5M; net income rose 69.1% y/y to $343.8M. Diluted EPS was $1.65, up 73.7% y/y (EPS basic $1.70, up 73.5% y/y). Total cash was roughly flat at $1,046.5M (+0.8% y/y); long-term debt was flat y/y at $2,377.1M; shareholders' equity fell 54.3% y/y to $682.4M.
